mathematical_result.statement: For an independent cap-m scalar hub H and two independent product banks supplying (L,V,P), with honest total-L density cap M_L and two-bank curved-tube currency K, the canonical nonzero-coupling form 2HL+2bLP+lambda(V+sL+v0)^2+affine terms has essential density at most inf_{0<R<=1}[m/(2R)+m M_L(2+sqrt(2)+log_2^+(C_T^2 K^2 R/(16|b|m^2M_L^2)))]. Thus the punctured deterioration is logarithmic in 1/|b| rather than a negative power.
mathematical_result.noncritical_refinement: At |t-gamma0|>=1, the stronger source tube gives p_Q(t)<=inf_R{(C_T/4)R[K_2(1+2log2+log_+(1/(|b|R)))+K_3]+m/(2R)}, hence O(sqrt(log(1/|b|))) after optimization.

pinned_source_application.application: For Q_b=2HL+2bLP+lambda(V+sL)^2+alpha L^2 with residual orthonormal frame (p,ell,v), active vector w=(e_h+b p)/sqrt(1+b^2) gives det M_b=-(1+b^2)lambda. If residual row leverages p_j^2+ell_j^2+v_j^2<=1/2 and |b|>=1, all active leverages are <=1/2, so ||p_Q||inf<=12[(1+b^2)|lambda|]^(-1/3)<=12. For 0<|b|<1, deleting the hub gives the nonuniform 12(|lambda|b^2)^(-1/3), which the new logarithmic bridge improves.

partner_result_applied.application: At theta=1/8 and standard m>=3/20, either ||p_Q||inf<194.229836362 mu^(-1/3), or one literal-coordinate descent leaves m'>7m/8, sigma'^2<=5sigma^2/8 and increases m^2/sigma^2 by at least 49/40.

premises_and_guards: No moments, support bounds, log-concavity, diagonal-basis independence, or post-rotation independence.
The basic two-bank curved estimate is used only on shell radii r<=1.
The one-dimensional L cap is an honest marginal bound from product-projection provenance, not a conditional cap.
No unrestricted curved-fiber supremum or interval-to-Borel promotion is used.
The coupling bP is never treated as a small random error.
Affine/sheared transverse squares are normalized by deterministic within-bank shear/scaling; independence between banks is preserved and density caps do not worsen when |lambda|>=1.
next_step: Interpolate the exact b=0 Borel square-root pushforward with the b!=0 two-bank oscillatory gain before arbitrary-set maximalisation, targeting a uniform critical-window estimate.
